title.value: A Study of Condition Numbers for First-Order Optimization
title.justification: The title is directly and clearly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: A Study of Condition Numbers for First-Order Optimization

analysis.description: This paper explores the impact of perturbations on the condition numbers used in tuning first-order optimization algorithms. It introduces a new norm for evaluating these perturbations and proposes alternative metrics that prove to be continuous and robust, offering insights into better tuning strategies for optimization algorithms.

type.justification: The paper provides a new theoretical framework and proposes new metrics and their properties, focusing on theoretical analysis rather than empirical validation.
type.quote: This paper introduces a new topology, based on the definition of a star-norm...

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on first-order optimization algorithms and their convergence properties.
name.quote: The study of first-order optimization algorithms (FOA) typically starts with assumptions on the objective functions...

name.justification: The application domain of the study is in fitting machine learning models using optimization algorithms.
name.quote: Optimization of a high-dimensional cost function is at the core of fitting most machine learning models.

name.justification: Gradient Descent is explicitly analyzed and discussed regarding the convergence rates based on various assumptions.
name.quote: We describe their mutual relations and provide their guaranteed convergence rates for the Gradient Descent algorithm accordingly tuned.

is_contributed.justification: The paper analyzes existing optimization algorithms and does not introduce Gradient Descent as a new contribution.
is_contributed.quote: We describe their mutual relations and provide their guaranteed convergence rates for the Gradient Descent algorithm accordingly tuned.

is_executed.justification: The paper conducts theoretical analysis on the execution of GD concerning different conditions and perturbations.
is_executed.quote: Finally we discuss how our work impacts the theoretical understanding of FOA and their performances.

is_compared.justification: GD is compared with other algorithms regarding the tuning based on condition numbers.
is_compared.quote: The paper discusses how alternative metrics provide different convergence rates when applied to Gradient Descent.
